title: International RSE Survey 2018 — Germany
text:
Survey overview
This book presents the 2018 survey independently for Germany, using the questions and answer options stored in that year’s export.
Country scope: Germany
Source records: 997
Records matching country scope: 333
Respondents included: 333
Question groups discovered: 67
This export has no submitdate_0 field, so all 333 rows are included.
Only respondents whose socio1_0 value is Germany are included.
No cross-year harmonisation is applied.
